claims: Dusty May is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Michigan.
Dusty May was hired on March 24, 2024, as the 18th head coach in Michigan men's basketball history.
Dusty May was the head coach at Florida Atlantic University from 2018 to 2024.
Dusty May led Florida Atlantic University to the 2023 Final Four.
Dusty May was named USBWA National Coach of the Year in 2026.
In his first season at Michigan, Dusty May led the team to a 27-10 record.
The Michigan men's basketball team had an 8-24 record the season before Dusty May's first season at Michigan.
Per the Wolverines Wire report, under Dusty May's leadership the Michigan men's basketball team secured the Big Ten regular-season title in the 2025-26 season.
Per the Wolverines Wire report, the Michigan men's basketball team was a 1-seed in the NCAA Tournament in the 2025-26 season.
Per the Wolverines Wire report, the Michigan men's basketball team made a Final Four appearance in the 2025-26 season.
